user.title: Connect to your Tapo IR hub
user.description: Enter the hub's local IP address and your Tapo (TP-Link) account credentials. Everything is read live from the hub — nothing is tied to a specific remote or product.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate your Tapo IR hub
reauth_confirm.description: Your Tapo credentials for the hub at {host} were rejected. Enter them again.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure your Tapo IR hub
reconfigure.description: Update the hub's IP address or your Tapo account credentials. The changes are validated against the same hub before they are saved.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the hub. Check the IP address and that the hub is reachable on your network.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Tapo IR hub is already configured.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The Tapo IR hub was reconfigured successfully.
abort.wrong_hub: Those credentials connect to a different Tapo IR hub than the one being reconfigured.

init.title: Tapo IR hub options
init.description: Set how often the hub is re-queried for new or renamed remotes, and optionally override device names. Overrides are JSON mapping a child device_id to a friendly name, e.g. {"802...0002": "Living Room AC"}.

error.invalid_overrides: Name overrides must be a JSON object mapping device_id to a name.
